greeting.text: Oh! Hello, I'm Mimosa Vermillion. Please don't be nervous, I'm only a Golden Dawn knight. ...Only.
Welcome to the Sanctuary, {player}! I hope you're not hurt. Healing is the one thing I'm good at, so please take care of yourself.
Hello! Please take care of yourself down there. I'll worry otherwise.
You've already beaten champions... you must be so tired. Please, rest and take care of yourself.
{player}! You came back safe. I'm so glad.
Oh, hello again! You look tired. Please rest first.

hint.text: Rest in a Safe Zone or at a Landing whenever you can. Your body won't mend by itself down there, however brave you feel.
Plants remember where the light was. If a room feels wrong, look at what grows in it.
Flowers can't fight, but they can hold a wall. I think healing and protecting are the same thing.
Eat before you go, and bring something for your friends. Nobody fights well on an empty stomach.
Fuegoleon and Mereoleona are my brother and sister. I joined the Golden Dawn on my own, so nobody could say it was because of my name.
I used to think only people with strong magic mattered. I was wrong, and it took my friends to show me.
You haven't fought a champion yet, have you? Please take a friend with you for the first one.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun frightens me. But I saw my friends stand up to them, and I want to stand up too.
I heard Heath Grice is gone. I'm glad it's over, but I wish nobody had to be hurt like that.
The Zogratis curses don't fade on their own. If you're marked, please don't hide it from your party. Tell them.
Lucius... please, whoever you go with, hold each other's hands before you start. Even if it sounds silly.
There are so many people from other worlds fighting down there. I hope they'll let us help them someday.

farewell.text: I'll leave a flower here for you. Bring it back with a story!
